lines.en: I walk the wood on stone feet.

lines.zh: 岩冠把我的头压得低低的。
lines.en: My stone crown keeps my head low.
I skirt the originium vein.
My tail is a string of stones.
Every step lands solid.
I follow the ravine a while.
Stone plates click on my back.
This crown of rock sits heavy.
I smell something familiar.

lines.zh: 我在林间空地转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the forest clearing.
Wind blows grit off me.

lines.zh: 我绕过矿脉，走到你侧面。
lines.en: I skirt the vein and come to your side.

lines.zh: 石头做的爪子踩碎了枝。
lines.en: Stone claws snap a twig.
I sit. Like a boulder.
My crown pales in moonlight.
I listen to the stone's low hum.
The oriforest wind is clean.
I need no sleep. Only rest.
I lick a stone paw. Cold.
Grass sprouts in my seams.
I count the sounds of the wood.
If someone comes, I hear first.
My breath shifts the plates.
I lie low like a rock.
I know these bounds.

lines.zh: 我在等一个肯靠近的人。
lines.en: I wait for one willing to come close.
The crown is heavy. I bear it.
Rainwater pools in my seams.
No trace of originium on you.
Do not fear. I do not bite strangers.

lines.zh: 林子里的源石味，我认路。
lines.en: I know the way by the originium smell in the woods.

lines.zh: 我头上的冠，是石头长的。
lines.en: This crown grew from stone.
Crouch, and I will come.
Few guests in this wood.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底有源石的味道。
lines.en: There is originium on your soles.
That iron is good.
Do not touch my crown. It cuts.
Do you mean to take me along?
I have waited many days.
The stone crown on my head is heavy.
Stone learns faces too.

lines.zh: 你手上有土，刚从矿边来？
lines.en: Dirt on your hands. From the vein?
I will follow, slowly.
Give me a piece of iron first.
Your scent is faint. New.
Looking up costs me effort.

lines.zh: 你蹲下的时候，我不紧张。
lines.en: When you crouch, I stop tensing.
One step between us still.
A piece of stone breaks off.
My crown tilts. I straighten it.
One step back; dust falls.
Stone does not hurt. Only chips.
Well struck, human.
I growl and hold my ground.
One leg locks for a moment.
Grit lodges in my seams.
I remember your scent now.
Still up. Stone does not fall.
Iron? That I want.
Set the iron down and I come.
Not originium. Too sharp.
That iron lasts me two days.

lines.zh: 我不吃生肉，只吃石与铁。
lines.en: Not raw meat. Stone and iron.
Lend me a bite of your sword.
Ordinary quality. Acceptable.

lines.zh: 你把铁举高了，我够不到。
lines.en: Too high. I cannot reach.
Filings on the ground. Do not waste them.
Finish this, and I follow.
Iron tastes cleaner than the stone.

lines.zh: 你把铁块敲两下，我听听。
lines.en: Tap the iron twice. Let me hear it.
The rusty one. I will take that too.
With iron in my jaws, my steps steady.
One piece, and I will lie down.
Not on my crown. It rings.
Filings beat grass any day.
Hit me and you hit a hill.
My stone shoulder is hard. Careful.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我身上的灰落下。
lines.en: One bump and dust falls off me.

lines.zh: 我头顶这块岩冠，压得住。
lines.en: This stone crown on my head holds weight.

lines.zh: 别踩我的尾巴，那是石头。
lines.en: Not the tail. It is stone.
Your hand hurts now, does it not?
I do not shove. I block.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我的冠晃了一下。
lines.en: The bump rocks my crown.
You step back; I lower my head.
That way, you lose.
Stone does not speak of that.
I grew out of the vein.

lines.zh: 我的同类都在更深的山里。
lines.en: My kind are deeper in the hills.
That question dulls me.
I would rather find good iron.
Ask no more. Stone cannot blush.
We are not born.
The stone gives shape, not family.
Lower your hand first.

lines.zh: 换个话题，我给你看石头。
lines.en: Another topic. I will show you stones.
I take this iron in my jaws.
I pick up your dropped iron.

lines.zh: 地上的石块，我拨到一边。
lines.en: I nudge a stone aside.
I hold this iron plate and will not let go.
Too soft. Not good eating.
This stone in my mouth steadies me.
I could bite through that bracer.
I will return it after.
Something is wedged in my seam.
This is mine. Agreed?
Head low, crown forward.

lines.zh: 我抬头，冠上的石屑掉了。
lines.en: I lift my head; grit falls from my crown.
I start toward you.
Stone on stone. Loud.
I mark your hands.

lines.zh: 我没恶意，只是想咬一口。
lines.en: No malice. I only want a bite.
You retreat. I follow, slowly.
I will not hold back this charge.
My crown faces you. Brace.

lines.zh: 你听见石片摩擦的声吗？
lines.en: Hear the plates grind?

lines.zh: 我的石足碾碎了一根枯枝。
lines.en: My stone foot crushes a dead branch.
My stone feet sink in soil.
Your back is nearly against the trunk.

lines.zh: 你踩断枝条的声音很清楚。
lines.en: The twig you snapped was loud.
The stone's smell excites me.
My crown is too heavy to lift.
Run and I give chase.

lines.zh: 石爪在地上留了三道沟。
lines.en: My claws leave three grooves.
I wait for you to drop the iron.
Hear me breathe?
My crown hits your side.
Stone claws rake your armor.
That knocks you back.
I bite down on your bracer.
You thought stone would not pounce?
I crash down; earth sprays.

lines.zh: 我的冠撞歪了你的护膝。
lines.en: My crown knocks your knee guard askew.

lines.zh: 石头碰骨头，我只用了半分力。
lines.en: Stone on bone, and I used half my strength.
My claws scrape your shield.
You held. I am surprised.
Movement in the stone pile.

lines.zh: oriforest 的边缘多了一块岩。
lines.en: A boulder joins the oriforest edge.
I rise beside the originium vein.
The crown breaks the soil.
Wind lifts the grit.
Hear the stones walking?
My stone claws sink into the loose soil.

lines.zh: 林子深处有石头在呼吸。
lines.en: Stone breathes in the deep wood.
One step flattens the grass.
I keep this ground.
Fire heats my stone plates.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，碎了一角。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and chip.
Water seeps in. I grow heavier.
The blast flings off my crown.
The arrow rebounds off my hide.
Magic softens my stone legs.
Nothing to chew and I go dull.

lines.zh: 雷电劈在我背上，石头发亮。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back; the stone glows.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，石头也抓不住。
lines.en: The ground gives. Stone cannot grip.
